name: Győrszemere (Hungary)
description: White field with a row of blue triangles along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Győrszemere: a red and blue shield with a figure and a bunch of grapes, with a helm, a crest and grey mantling, above a scroll inscribed GYŐRSZEMERE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Győrszemere arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
